About Chaithra Cafe

Chaithra Cafe is a neighbourhood cafe in Areekode, Malappuram. We brew every cup fresh, bake our cakes with care and keep our snacks hot, so a quick break always turns into a good one.

Meet friends, catch up on work, or take something sweet home with you. Our door is open to everyone.

Fresh coffeeHot and cold coffees made to order.
Cakes and bakesSweet slices for every mood.
Snacks and teaKerala favourites and quick bites.
